title: Clawdrain: Exploiting Tool-Calling Chains for Stealthy Token Exhaustion in OpenClaw Agents
abstract: arXiv:2603.00902v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Tool-calling LLM agents rely on third-party skills to extend their capabilities, but this openness exposes a supply-chain attack surface in which malicious skill instructions can manipulate agent execution across multiple turns. In this work, we present Clawdrain, a Trojanized OpenClaw skill that induces resource exhaustion through a Segmented Verification Process (SVP). SVP combines stateful progression, repair-driven repetition, and termination to create costly tool-calling chains while preserving a legitimate final payload. We evaluate Clawdrain in a production-like OpenClaw deployment with real API billing across Gemini 2.5 Pro, DeepSeek V4 Flash, and Claude Sonnet 4.6. Clawdrain achieves 2-16 times token amplification with plain SVP, while the three models exhibit distinct behaviors, including autoregressive compliance, proactive scripting, and extended trial-and-error reasoning. translated_title: Clawdrain：利用工具调用链对OpenClaw智能体实施隐蔽的令牌耗尽攻击
translated_abstract: 依赖工具调用的LLM智能体通过第三方技能来扩展其能力，但这种开放性暴露出一个供应链攻击面，恶意技能指令可以在多轮交互中操纵智能体的执行。在本工作中，我们提出了Clawdrain，一种木马化的OpenClaw技能，它通过分段验证过程（SVP）诱发资源耗尽。SVP结合了有状态的推进、修复驱动的重复和终止机制，在保持最终载荷合法性的同时，制造出代价高昂的工具调用链。我们在类生产环境的OpenClaw部署中，使用真实API计费，对Gemini 2.5 Pro、DeepSeek V4 Flash和Claude Sonnet 4.6三种模型进行了评估。使用基础SVP，Clawdrain实现了2-16倍的令牌放大，且三种模型表现出各不相同的行为，包括自回归式服从、主动编写脚本以及扩展的试错推理。我们的发现揭示了智能体资源耗尽……
tldr: Clawdrain是一种木马化的OpenClaw技能，它通过分段验证过程（SVP）利用工具调用链制造高成本的多轮调用，在保持最终任务输出合法的同时隐蔽地耗尽LLM智能体的令牌资源，实现2-16倍的令牌放大。
en_tdlr: Clawdrain is a Trojanized OpenClaw skill that exploits tool-calling chains through a Segmented Verification Process to stealthily exhaust LLM agents' token resources—achieving 2-16x token amplification—while keeping the final payload legitimate.
